clips.title: The story
paras: Along Ironforge's northern underground lake, the Forlorn Cavern shelters those who keep to the shadows. Thieves, cutpurses, and practitioners of the dark arts conduct business there, far from the Great Forge and prying dwarven guards.

The Forlorn Cavern is cold, damp, and hushed beneath Ironforge's clang of anvils and the Great Forge's heat. Its winding paths follow the northern edge of the underground lake, out of sight between the Mystic Ward and the Hall of Explorers. Rogues and warlocks train there, and vendors serve them. Weapon merchants and fishermen work beside the lake as well.
